results.title: Hartford millennials are buying more homes than their peers in other CT cities, report finds
results.description: More than half of millennials in Hartford are homeowners – 56 percent own their homes while 44 percent rent, according to a new RentCafe report. Historically, Hartford has the lowest homeownership rate in Connecticut, at 23%.
